packs.name: Thames Loop
packs.blurb: Downriver on the south bank to Greenwich, under the Thames on foot, then home along the north bank through the old docks, Limehouse and Wapping.

packs.name: Royal Docks Loop
packs.blurb: Out on Cycleway 3 through Cable Street and Poplar to the Royal Docks, back up the River Lea and home through the East End.

packs.name: Chelsea Loop
packs.blurb: West through Bloomsbury and Hyde Park to Chelsea, then home along the river past MI5 and MI6.
